**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to engage *any* supplier, and records that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** backs this up: no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and a decision not to place another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 13.1 (p0054)** grants only a *non-exclusive* access right — no sourcing obligation.
- **§ 12.4 (p0052)** is exclusivity running *against* Vendor (no directly competing analytics service), which benefits us and is expressly not a deviation under the rule.

Targeted searches for "sole/exclusive provider", "all of its requirements", third-party procurement bars, and portal/marketplace sourcing mechanics returned no clause binding Customer. No redline proposed.
